title: Who got under your skin?
subtitle: A few minutes. No right answers.

steps.body: Before we begin — take a breath. Let yourself arrive.

steps.title: Who got under your skin today?
steps.body: A person, a moment, a kind of person. Whatever still has a charge.

steps.title: What exactly bothered you — and what quality is that?
steps.body: Not what they did. The trait underneath it. Their arrogance? Neediness? The way they didn't seem to care?

steps.title: How strong was the charge?
steps.body: Just for you. The strength is the signal — it points at something.
That landed with some weight. Take one breath here before going on — there's no rush.

steps.title: Where have you felt this before?
steps.body: Does this reaction rhyme with anything older? You don't have to find an answer.

steps.title: Is there any way this lives in you too?
steps.body: No need to force a yes. Sometimes it's a clear no. Sometimes it's the part you've worked hardest never to be.

exit.body: That's enough. You noticed something — that's the whole practice.
